Class SlotPlacement

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.slot.SlotPlacement
public final class SlotPlacement extends Object
MenuKit Placements against slots, for a panel's in(ModeScope, Placement) (since 2.1.0). Client only. 
Panel elytra = Panel.builder("mymod:elytra")
        .add(SlotFlowElement.of(ELYTRA_SLOT))
        .in(ModeScope.SURVIVAL, SlotPlacement.slot(Address.playerInventory(40), 0, -18))  // above the offhand
        .in(ModeScope.CREATIVE, SlotPlacement.slot(Address.playerInventory(38), 18, 0))   // right of the chestplate
        .build();
new AnchorPanelAdapter(elytra);

Presence

A slot or group placement shows where that slot or group is on the open menu this frame, and nowhere else. Armor isn't on a creative item tab, so a panel placed on an armor slot doesn't draw there, with no tab check in the mod.

Declare at init

The first placement on a slot or group declares its MenuKit anchor, which MenuKit allows only before its declarations freeze at client start. Build panels at init. A custom menu's own panels (ClientMenu.panel) are built on each open and placed by the menu's screen, so they take screen placements only, not these.

  • Method Details

    • slot

      public static com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.Placement slot(Address address, int dx, int dy)
      At the slot address names, (dx, dy) from the top-left of its 18x18 frame, at the panel's natural size. Nothing moves it apart from another panel there or keeps it on the screen. A panel holding one slot at (0, -18) with no padding sits one slot above, on vanilla's grid.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when address doesn't name a slot

    • group

      public static com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.Placement group(SlotGroupId group, com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.PanelPosition position)
      Around a slot group's box: region(OutsideRegion) stacks with the group's other panels by priority, as a SlotGroupPanelAdapter did; center() and pixel(...) work as anywhere. A panel holding slots keeps vanilla's pitch with gap(0).

    • group

      public static com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.Placement group(SlotGroupCategory category, com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.PanelPosition position)
      group(SlotGroupId, PanelPosition) on a category's vanilla group. For a panel on every group of the category, created ones too, see CategoryPanels.
